evaluations.claim: On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it slightly outperforms Ours (Iterative RLHF) with a score of 70% compared to 65%.
evaluations.reality: Both models actually perform equally on MMLU, with scores of approximately 65%.

evaluations.claim: For HumanEval, Ours (Iterative RLHF) shows a notable improvement, scoring 70% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it's 60%.
evaluations.reality: Ours (Iterative RLHF) scores approximately 63%, not 70%, and the difference between the models is much smaller.

evaluations.claim: TruthfulQA demonstrates a consistent upward trend for both models, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) reaching 65% and LLaMA-3-8B-it trailing at 45%.
evaluations.reality: TruthfulQA does not show a consistent upward trend; the scores are static, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) at approximately 60% and LLaMA-3-8B-it at 45%.
evaluations.reason: Description highlights upward trend for TruthfulQA scores.
